caption: The drawing depicts a metal cylindrical container with a slightly domed, hinged lid that is partially open. The container is predominantly grayish-green with areas of rust and wear, suggesting aged or weathered metal. The vessel has vertical ribbed indentations running along its body and features embossed lettering that reads “12-1878 QUEEN.” There is a solid, curved spout attached near the lower portion of the cylinder for pouring and a black handle affixed to the upper side, which appears to be made of a different material, possibly wood or Bakelite. The handle is secured with a metal bracket that is visible in the image. The background is plain and off-white, and the drawing is composed with the object centered, showing a clear view of its details, textures, and colors.
title: Syrup Container
